== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Shyrax the Third]] is the rightful ruler of the planet [[Karosha]], though she currently exists in exile. Having ascended to the [[throne]] nine years ago following her mother's abdication, she was later convicted of treason by the [[Dragon Court]]. This conviction allowed her cousin, [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]], to claim the [[throne]] in her stead. Now leading a rebel movement, she commands a fleet of [[Karoshan]] starships and seeks to reclaim her position as the legitimate monarch. Physically, she is characterized by bronze skin, golden hair-cables, and a commanding presence. She is often seen in combat-ready attire featuring [[dragon]] motifs and integrated shield generators, and she has demonstrated significant physical strength and magical ability in battle. [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has formed alliances with various groups, including the crew of [[The Last Horizon]], as she navigates an imperial civil war to restore her rule.}}
